debug.description: Debugging options. If `enabled` is true, enables debug output to stderr or logfile. `logfile` and `loglevel` further configure debug logging. See --debug, --debug-logfile, --debug-loglevel in gphoto2(1).

debug.logfile.description: Path to file where debug output is written when --debug is enabled. Overrides stderr default.

debug.loglevel.description: Debug verbosity level. Valid values: error, debug, data, all.

hook_script.description: Path to hook script executed at gphoto2 events (ACTION=init/start/stop/download). See --hook-script in gphoto2(1).

quiet.description: Enable quiet mode (--quiet). Supersedes verbose mode if both are set.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode (--verbose). Ignored if quiet is true.

filename_pattern.description: Filename pattern for downloads/uploads (e.g., '%n.jpg'). Supports %a,%d,%H,%n,%C,%F etc. See --filename in gphoto2(1).

filenumber_start.description: Starting number for %n expansion in filename pattern. Default is 1. See --filenumber in gphoto2(1).

usbid_rules.description: List of USB ID override rules. See --usbid in gphoto2(1). Each rule maps a detected ID to a treated-as ID.

camera_model.description: Camera model name as listed by --list-cameras. Required when using --camera. See --camera in gphoto2(1).

port.description: Port path (e.g., 'usb:001,002'). Required when using --camera. See --port in gphoto2(1).

speed.description: Serial transfer speed in baud (e.g., 9600). Ignored for USB ports. See --speed in gphoto2(1).

folder.description: Camera folder to operate on. Default is root folder '/'. See --folder in gphoto2(1).

recurse.description: Whether to recurse into subfolders for operations that support it (e.g., --list-files, --get-all-files). Default true. --no-recurse is emitted if false.

capture_keep.description: If true, emit --keep to retain captured images on camera after download. Mutually exclusive with capture_keep_raw.

capture_keep_raw.description: If true, emit --keep-raw to retain RAW images on camera while JPEGs are downloaded. Mutually exclusive with capture_keep.

capture_frames.description: Number of frames to capture in time-lapse mode. Default is infinite (no --frames emitted). See --frames in gphoto2(1).

capture_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between captures in time-lapse mode. A value of -1 means wait indefinitely (SIGUSR1 to capture). See --interval in gphoto2(1).

capture_reset_interval.description: If true, emit --reset-interval to reset interval timer on SIGUSR1. See --reset-interval in gphoto2(1).

capture_tethered.description: Tethered capture wait specification: 'SECONDS', 'COUNT', 'SECONDS, COUNT', or 'MATCHSTRING'. See --capture-tethered in gphoto2(1).
